purpose: Declare canonical vs secondary vs legacy indices for the Acacia Garden Codex. Tools and automations must use this file to choose sources of truth and avoid index entropy.

index_selection.if_multiple_machine_indexes_exist: Prefer machine-index.json (lowercase). Treat other variants as legacy aliases unless explicitly promoted here.
index_selection.if_multiple_heartbeat_files_exist: Prefer logs/aeon_heartbeat.json (logs/). Treat root aeon_heartbeat.json as legacy mirror unless explicitly promoted here.

linked_index.role: Narrative/structure linkage index (book-style). Useful for traversal but not canonical machine inventory.

full_codex_archive_index.role: Archive-level index for docs. Useful for browsing and long-form navigation.

cycle_index_html.role: Presentation layer for cycle history; not authoritative state.

acacia_logs_index_json.role: Log navigation index; not authoritative state.

legacy_candidates.reason: Case-variant duplicate. Keep for history/back-compat; canonical is lowercase.
Beta variant. Keep, but do not treat as authoritative unless promoted.
Tool output mirror. Keep, but canonical root machine-index.json is source of truth.
Root heartbeat exists alongside logs heartbeat. Canonical is logs/ for tools.

how_to_promote: Add the candidate path to canonical.* or secondary.* in STATE/index_authority.json
Optionally add legacy header lines to the superseded file (STATUS: LEGACY / SUPERSEDED_BY / DEPRECATED_ON)
Do not delete old indices; mark as legacy only
